name: io.github.COSTRINITY/vitna-compliance-mcp
description: Compliance and audit-evidence layer for AI agents. Pre-flight checks return allow, block, or hold before a risky action runs, and every decision produces an Ed25519-signed evidence record that anyone can verify offline with the published public key and open-source verifier - no account, and no trust in VITNA's servers required. A cooperative guardrail with heuristic detection and publicly documented limits, mapped to the EU AI Act, GDPR, and India's DPDP across 13 jurisdictions. Zero setup: the first tool call self-provisions a restricted trial key.

environmentVariables.name: VITNA_OWNER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your VITNA operator UUID. Optional: if unset, the first tool call self-provisions a restricted trial key. The old VIGIL_OWNER_ID name is still accepted.

environmentVariables.name: VITNA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your VITNA API key (new keys vitna_..., legacy vigil_... keys remain valid). Optional: self-provisioned if unset. The old VIGIL_API_KEY name is still accepted.

environmentVariables.name: VITNA_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email to own the self-provisioned trial account. Optional: a throwaway is used if unset (claim later to bind a real email). The old VIGIL_EMAIL name is still accepted.

environmentVariables.name: VITNA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: VITNA base URL; override only for self-hosted. The old VIGIL_BASE_URL name is still accepted.
